items.title: At SIGGRAPH, NVIDIA advances graphics and simulation with agentic and physical AI
items.excerpt: At SIGGRAPH 2026 NVIDIA unveiled neural-rendering breakthroughs and world foundation models (Cosmos 3 Edge) for real-time 4K content creation with more artistic control, plus 22 graphics-research advances. It also expanded Model Context Protocol integrations so AI agents can work directly inside creative tools like Blender, Unreal Engine and Adobe Creative Cloud while keeping creative decisions under human supervision.

items.title: Ethical, low-power, and on-device: Studio Atelico's vision for the future of generative AI
items.excerpt: Studio Atelico lays out a vision for ethical, low-power, on-device generative AI in games. Its debut title, Bobium Brawlers, blends "classic game design with the possibilities of AI" — and, importantly, all the artists on the project are paid, positioning the studio against the extractive-AI backlash in the industry.

items.title: Persona and Shin Megami Tensei artist isn't using generative AI in his next game following backlash to his last 2 deckbuilders
items.excerpt: Veteran Persona and Shin Megami Tensei artist Kazuma Kaneko says he will not use generative AI in his next game after fan backlash to his last two AI-assisted deckbuilders, noting "it's quicker for me to draw it myself" — a pointed data point on where hand-craft still beats AI in game art workflows.

items.title: New method teaches AI to make 2D designs 3D
items.excerpt: Researchers demonstrate a new AI method that converts flat 2D designs and drawings into fully realized 3D models — a capability with direct implications for game asset-creation pipelines, letting concept art be lifted into game-ready geometry with far less manual modeling.

items.title: "Built for that world doesn't mean built to require it": Unity reveal their next game engine while walking a careful line around generative AI
items.excerpt: Unity announced Unity 7, and — in a pleasant shock — it doesn't appear to break existing projects. RPS digs into how Unity is positioning generative AI in the new engine: built to support AI-assisted workflows without requiring them, an explicit stance amid developer wariness about AI-first tooling.
